sources.title: Kev metrics at fixed commit
sources.authority_reason: Kev作者的固定官方實作，直接定義coverage/error曲線與cluster重採樣。
sources.inspection_note: Read coverage_at_error, risk_coverage_curve, cluster_resamples and paired_bootstrap. Post-hoc maximum coverage reads correctness; group resampling keeps sibling questions/variants together.

sources.title: Kev DecisionHead and serving prefix implementation
sources.authority_reason: Kev作者官方模型原始碼；直接定義溫度與cache資料路徑。
sources.inspection_note: Read DecisionHead and the full prefix/probs_and_prefix/probs_with_prefix/_branch_rows_from_prefix path. T divides logits once at eval; hybrid cache contains KV, convolution and recurrent state and branches copy state.

sources.title: Kev checkpoint loader
sources.authority_reason: Kev官方checkpoint layout與載入函式；決定base/tokenizer/head及dtype/T。
sources.inspection_note: Read checkpoint layout/Meta/LoadOptions and torch load path. Tokenizer is loaded from pinned base revision, head from checkpoint; explicit float32 and temperature=1 override defaults.

sources.title: Kev shared-prefix state representation
sources.authority_reason: Kev官方實作，說明hybrid模型的KV、卷積與循環狀態；與本次diagnostic scope分開。
sources.inspection_note: Read header, Prefix and functional state gathering. Distinguishes attention KV and DeltaNet convolution/recurrent state; this training helper is not a replacement for the research serving cache test.

sources.title: Kev-4B model card at exact adapter revision
sources.authority_reason: 模型發布者對用途、語言、精度及限制的原始卡片。
sources.inspection_note: Read intended task, English scope, raw probability mode, FP32 evaluation, order sensitivity and pretrained/base provenance; card numbers are not substituted for this experiment.

sources.title: Kev-4B exact adapter config
sources.authority_reason: 發布者固定模型config，提供base、LoRA與feature-extraction身分。
sources.inspection_note: Read original config, distinguish training autocast from stored weights and this experiment direct FP32 load.

sources.title: Kev-4B exact training config
sources.authority_reason: 發布者保存的訓練config；區分bf16 autocast、FP32 weights與本輪載入。
sources.inspection_note: Read original config, distinguish training autocast from stored weights and this experiment direct FP32 load.

sources.inspection_note: Read complete released 3B config. Audio input, vision input, Talker and Token2Wav are configured; presence is not proof the aborted worker loaded any component.

sources.title: Qwen2.5-Omni-3B Research License
sources.authority_reason: 該3B版本發布者附帶的完整原始LICENSE，直接管該Materials。
sources.inspection_note: Read full research license. Non-Commercial is research/evaluation, commercial use requires a separate license. Redistribution conditions and model-improvement attribution are separate; no blanket prohibition on outputs is inferred.

sources.title: Transformers Qwen2.5-Omni processor
sources.authority_reason: Hugging Face官方固定v4.57.6原始碼，與原研究requirements一致。
sources.inspection_note: Read processor __call__ and multimodal placeholder expansion. videos_kwargs fps and use_audio_in_video affect time coordinates and interleaving; metadata alone is insufficient to certify actual worker processor tensors.

sources.title: Transformers Qwen2.5-Omni generate implementation
sources.authority_reason: 官方固定v4.57.6 generate回傳與waveform生成路徑。
sources.inspection_note: Read Qwen2_5OmniForConditionalGeneration.generate in full. Requested speech is decoded after Talker.generate and returned as one tensor tuple; it is not a generator yielding playable chunks. No worker output is claimed.

sources.title: Qwen2.5-Omni Technical Report
sources.authority_reason: Qwen原作者報告v1；核對前處理、時間位置、串流與語音評測，而非沿用卡片或作者摘要。
sources.inspection_note: Read original architecture, input sampling/temporal coordinates, streaming block context, and speech evaluation. Content consistency (WER), speaker similarity and subjective naturalness are separately assessed. These are paper methods, not this 3B attempt results.

sources.title: Qwen3-Omni Technical Report
sources.authority_reason: Qwen原作者報告v1；Table2才是234ms的原始出處。
sources.inspection_note: Read streaming generation and concurrency section, including theoretical latency table and vLLM/compile/CUDA Graph conditions. 234ms is single-concurrency audio first-packet latency for 30B-A3B; 547ms is video. Neither is measured by this 3B work.

sources.title: On Calibration of Modern Neural Networks
sources.authority_reason: Guo等人的PMLR原論文，§4.2 Eq.9直接說明T的NLL擬合與argmax不變。
sources.inspection_note: Read original multiclass calibration section and Eq. 9; positive scalar T fit to validation NLL changes confidence, not argmax.

sources.title: 配對、接受風險與證據邊界的透明推導
sources.details: 配對成功=兩觀察correct的AND；逐題率=(每題correct總和)/(題數)，配對率=(每家族AND總和)/(家族數)。coverage=accepted/n；accepted risk=errors/accepted，accepted=0時除法未定義記None。改ID不會改底層情境的相依性。T>0使logit大小關係不變，softmax亦單調，因此argmax不變。模型/processor沒有被執行或沒有輸出，不能由該次啟動失敗推出模型答題品質、VRAM需求或別台電腦行為。單一被接受樣本的零錯只是一次觀察，不是母體風險上界。
